card.name: Verbs after 'patients who' in warnings
card.fires_on: Verbs like experience, develop or reported, and symptom/reaction nouns, in warnings about adverse events. It is strongest right after 'patients who' or 'was reported'.

modes.label: After 'patients who'
modes.description: The verb that follows 'patients who' in a consider-this-condition warning.
modes.example: Consider pancreatitis in patients who<< develop>> persistent severe abdominal pain.

modes.label: Reported or onset wording
modes.description: Reporting or timing words and symptom nouns in adverse event statements.
modes.example: Seizure was<< reported>> in patients taking LYNKUET
